_instructions: This file draws the 'Lower Logan River' schematic page (Guinavah Campground down to Cutler Terminus).
See public/schematics/README.md for the full field reference and a longer walkthrough - this is the quick version.
This page intentionally RECAPS Guinavah Campground, the Dewitt Springs Junction/tributary, the Cache Highline Canal
junction/diversion, Above First Dam, and the Water Lab station at its own top (same node ids as in upper-logan.json)
so the page reads as a complete, standalone diagram - even though those same live stations already appear at the
bottom of the Upper Logan Canyon page. This duplication is deliberate, not a bug - see the canonical site-ordering
reference, which lists these same rows again under 'Lower Logan River: Valley'.
NODES: each node is a card on the diagram, listed in the order the water actually flows.
id         - unique within this file. Tributaries/diversions/links reference another node's id via connectsTo.
name       - for kind 'mainstem'/'tributary'/'diversion', must fuzzy-match a live station's display name from
HydroServer/DWRi/USGS, unless stationId is set, in which case that always wins. For 'junction'/'link'
nodes it is just label text.
stationId  - optional but recommended: the exact station id/code to match instead of guessing from name - the same id
used in config/station_config.yaml (usgs_stations/dwri_stations), or a HydroServer station code (a
display_names key, e.g. 'BC_CONF_A'). See README.md for details.
kind       - 'mainstem' (a real gauge station on the main channel), 'junction' (an invisible confluence point on the main
channel, no card - where a tributary/diversion attaches), 'tributary' (water flowing IN), 'diversion' (water
flowing OUT), or 'link' (a card with no live data of its own that just navigates to another schematic page).
connectsTo - tributary/diversion/link only: the id of the mainstem/junction node this attaches to. Every diversion
below connects DIRECTLY to its own dedicated junction (not chained onto another diversion) and keeps one
consistent side, per the canonical site-ordering reference. Chaining diversions together with alternating
sides was the cause of a real bug (arrows crossing straight over the main channel line) - don't
reintroduce that pattern here.
side       - tributary/diversion/link only, when connectsTo is set: 'left' or 'right', which side of the main channel
to draw the card on.
colorGroup - optional; must match a name from waterway_groups or schematic_groups in config/station_config.yaml.
linkTo     - optional on any node; the schematic page slug to navigate to on click. On a normal node this adds a
'view full system' button below its card; on a 'link' node it's the entire point of the card.
label      - linkTo button text override (defaults to name).
cardLabel  - optional; overrides the on-card name shown once matched to a live station - needed when the live
station's real displayName doesn't shorten well automatically. See README.md for the exact rule this
bypasses.
terminus   - mainstem only: marks this node as the system's final endpoint (only the 'terminus' node below should set
this).
description - terminus node only: subtitle text.
returnsTo  - tributary/diversion only: if this is the last node in a chain and the water rejoins the main channel
here, the id of the junction it rejoins at (see bsf_before_conf below, which rejoins at bsf_confluence).
Draws a second connector back into the trunk, rendered dashed to distinguish it from a primary connector.
There's no separate edges list - the main channel line, every tributary/diversion's connector, and flow direction (in
for tributary, out for diversion) are all derived automatically from kind + connectsTo + the order nodes appear above.
The 'bsf_ext' node is where Blacksmith Fork River used to be drawn directly on this page - it's now a 'link' card that
navigates to its own page (blacksmith-fork.json), plus one real preview station ('bsf_before_conf', the last BSF gauge
before it joins the Logan River - also the last real node on blacksmith-fork.json's own page) chained onto it, with
returnsTo pointing back at bsf_confluence so its connector rejoins the main trunk right where the real confluence is.
Do not delete bsf_ext without also removing the reciprocal 'to_lower_logan' link node on that page.
'little_bear' below is a real live station (Little Bear River: Mendon Road - the same station that's also the last
node on little-bear.json's own page) that ALSO carries linkTo to that page for a 'view full system' button, rather
than a nav-only link card - per the canonical site-ordering reference. Do not delete it without also removing the
reciprocal linkTo on that page's 'cutler_reservoir' terminus node.
Southwest Field Canal, Northwest Field Canal, Hyde Park and Logan Northfield, Hyde Park Canal, and Benson Irrigation
Company are marked 'future scope: not yet added to schematic' in the canonical site-ordering reference - do not add
them here until that reference is updated.
